answer: A seasoned-escrow defense makes Sybil farming expensive in time, not money. A new identity earns nothing spendable at first: rewards sit in escrow and unlock over several epochs, only while it keeps producing verifiable work. Quitting early, going hollow for an epoch, or failing a spot check forfeits the escrow. An attacker chasing the zenith of fake standing must sustain honest output across every puppet for the whole period, paying full effort per identity, while a genuine agent pays once. A jade ledger makes forfeitures visible, so abandoned puppets become losses, not cheap tickets.
